      Current Auto Batching Flow
      
          Draft - 08.08.2026
        
      
        
      
      
      
      
        
      This diagram records the currently implemented process. Each currency pair is evaluated independently.
      
        
      
          
      
            
      AutoBatch Process Starts
      
            
      Capture the process start time and Trade ID boundary. Load configured Currency Pairs and Tenor Compatibility.
      
            
      
              
                data_object
                Captured / Logged
                expand_more
              
              
      
                
      startedAtServer timestamp when the Auto Batch process starts.
      
                
      startBoundaryTradeIdLatest Trade ID already present at process start.
      
                
      eligibleCcyPairCodesConfigured Currency Pairs enabled for this process.
      
                
      tenorCompatibilityModeCurrently fixed as SAME_TENOR_ONLY.
      
              
      
            
      
          
      
          
      arrow_downward
      
          
      
            
      Select trades for this run
      
            
      Only new Client and Hedge Deals above the start boundary may open a window. Older FX Position trades remain under manual control.
      
          
      
          
      arrow_downward
      
          
      
            
      Build independent queues
      
            
      Group by Ccy Pair, Trade Date, Tenor, Value Dates and currency precision.
      
          
      
          
      arrow_downward
      
          
      
            
      Order by Received Timestamp
      
            
      Trade ID resolves equal timestamps.
      
          
      
          
      arrow_downward
      
          
      
            
      First eligible trade opens a Batching Window
      
            
      Deadline = first Received Timestamp + Maximum Batching Interval.
      
          
      
          
      arrow_downward
      
          
      
            
      Would the next trade breach the Transfer Rate corridor?
      
          
      
          
      
            
      
              Breach
              
      Close the window
      
              
      Reason: TRANSFER_RATE_CORRIDOR_BREACHED. The breaching trade starts the next window.
      
            
      
            
      
              Within corridor
              
      Add the trade
      
              
      Keep the current window open and continue evaluating it.
      
            
      
          
      
          
      arrow_downward
      
          
      
            
      Has the Maximum Batching Interval elapsed?
      
          
      
          
      
            
      
              Reached
              
      Close the window
      
              
      Reason: MAX_INTERVAL_REACHED.
      
            
      
            
      
              Not reached
              
      Wait for another trade
      
              
      Re-evaluate when a trade arrives or the deadline is reached.
      
            
      
          
      
          
      arrow_downward
      
          
      
            
      Does the closed window contain at least two eligible trades?
      
          
      
          
      
            
      
              Yes
              
      Form an FX Batch
      
              
      At most one candidate is formed per currency pair in one evaluation cycle.
      
            
      
            
      
              No
              
      Keep manual control
      
              
      Trades remain in FX Position and are excluded from the current Auto Batch run.
      
            
      
          
      
          
      arrow_downward
      
          
      
            
      Continue independently for each currency pair
      
          
      
        
      
        
      
          info
          Execution Timestamp is stored for trades but is not yet used by this Auto Batching flow.

            schema
            Technical Details
            expand_more
          
          
          
        
          Схема фиксирует текущий процесс, запускаемый кнопкой Create Batch, и отделяет временное состояние браузера от данных, сохраняемых сервером.
          
        
          
          
          
            
          Select FX Trades and click Create Batch
          
            
          Флажки на странице FX Position определяют выбранные исходные сделки. До нажатия Create Batch состояние выбора существует только в браузере.
          
            
          
              
                data_object
                Зафиксировано / сохранено
                expand_more
              
              
          
                
          selectedTradeIdsТекущий изменяемый набор выбранных Trade ID в памяти браузера; само состояние выбора не сохраняется.
          
                
          tradeIdsОкончательный отсортированный список, сформированный при нажатии Create Batch и отправленный серверу.
          
              
          
            
          
          
          
          
          arrow_downward
          
          
          
            
          Are one or more eligible FX Trades selected?
          
          
          
          
          
            
          
              Нет
              
          Stop before submission
          
              
          Показать предупреждение и оставить FX Position без изменений.
          
            
          
            
          
              Да
              
          Resolve a compatible selection
          
              
          One Batching Key continues immediately. If the selection is mixed, the dealer chooses one compatible group for this FX Batch.
          
            
          
          
          
          
          arrow_downward
          
          
          
            
          Prepare the Manual Batch Request
          
            
          The browser submits one compatible Trade selection. Mixed Batching Keys are never split into independent FX Batches.
          
            
          
              
                data_object
                Зафиксировано / сохранено
                expand_more
              
              
          
                
          idempotencyKeyСоздаётся в браузере и передаётся в заголовке запроса.
          
                
          tradeIdsОтсортированные числовые Trade ID, передаваемые в теле запроса.
          
              
          
            
          
          
          
          
          arrow_downward
          
          
          
            
          Validate the command and resolve idempotency
          
            
          The server accepts 1 to 200 unique positive Trade IDs. A matching completed request is replayed; reuse of the same key for a different command is rejected.
          
          
          
          
          arrow_downward
          
          
          
            
          Resolve and validate source Trades
          
            
          The server loads the exact requested Trade set, sorts it by Trade ID, and validates one common Batching Key. It never plans multiple manual FX Batches.
          
            
          
              
                data_object
                Зафиксировано / сохранено
                expand_more
              
              
          
                
          sourceTradeIdsThe exact sorted source selection used by the domain calculation and idempotent replay.
          
                
          Batching KeyCcy Pair, Trade Date, Tenor and both Value Dates must be compatible until technical FX Swap neutralization is implemented.
          
              
          
            
          
          
          
          
          arrow_downward
          
          
          
            
          Create the FX Batch Aggregate
          
            
          Create the single immutable FX Batch aggregate under the public request idempotency key.
          
            
          
              
                database
                Зафиксировано / сохранено
                expand_more
              
              
          
                
          batch_idPrimary identifier of the single record created in fx_batches.
          
                
          idempotency_keyНеизменяемый идентификатор запроса.
          
                
          fx_batch_membersThe exact immutable source Trade selection used for idempotent replay.
          
                
          batch_statusTransitions atomically from BUILDING to FORMED when the aggregate is complete.
          
              
          
            
          
          
          
          
          arrow_downward
          
          
          
            
          Form the FX Batch
          
            
          Загрузить полностью доступные исходные сделки, проверить наличие Transfer Rate и совместимость ключевых параметров, рассчитать чистые остатки и при необходимости создать Balance Trade, Position Out и Quote Cash Out.
          
            
          
              
                calculate
                Зафиксировано / сохранено
                expand_more
              
              
          
                
          formationReasonCodeПричина формирования: MANUAL_SELECTION.
          
                
          sourceTradeIdsОкончательные участники, переданные в доменный расчёт формирования батча.
          
                
          formation outputsРассчитываются в памяти до атомарного сохранения.
          
              
          
            
          
          
          
          
          arrow_downward
          
          
          
            
          Persist all results atomically
          
            
          Persist the Batch, all Trade members and technical outputs in one transaction. Any error rolls back the entire manual command.
          
            
          
              
                database
                Зафиксировано / сохранено
                expand_more
              
              
          
                
          fx_batchesЗаголовок сформированного батча и причина его формирования.
          
                
          fx_batch_membersСнимок состава исходных сделок батча.
          
                
          batch outputsPosition Out и Quote Cash Out, когда они требуются.
          
              
          
            
          
          
          
          
          arrow_downward
          
          
          
            
          Return the result and refresh FX Position
          
            
          Return the single Batch ID, reload FX Position, clear the submitted selection and request another Auto Batch evaluation.
          
          
          
        
          
        
          
          info
          В текущей реализации отдельный журнал событий по этапам отсутствует. Раскрывающиеся блоки показывают состояние браузера и записи базы данных, которые сейчас обеспечивают аудит процесса.
        
          
          
          
        
          
        
          
      
          

      
          
        
          
          
          
            
          Domain Glossary
          
            
          Core terms used across documented processes
          
          
          
        
          
        
          
          
          
            
          
              
          
                
          Auto Hedging
          
                
          An automated FX risk-management process that monitors open currency exposure and applies configured algorithms and controls to keep currency risk within approved limits.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Auto Hedging Admission
          
                
          The domain decision boundary that determines whether an FX Trade remains held under manual control or may be released to Auto Hedging.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Execution Context Admission Mode
          
                
          A mandatory Execution Context setting that defines the permitted admission path for its FX Trades.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Auto Hedging Admission Policy
          
                
          The complete set of mandatory rules that combines the Execution Context Admission Mode with configured Eligibility Checks to decide the Admission State.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Eligibility Check
          
                
          A safety condition evaluated from FX Trade, reference, or market data to determine eligibility for Auto Hedging. Every applicable check must pass before release.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Admission State
          
                
          Shows whether a specific FX Trade is currently held for manual control or released to Auto Hedging.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Ccy Pair
          
                
          An ordered pair of currencies defining the Base Currency and Quote Currency used to express an FX Trade amount and exchange rate.
          
              
          

              
          
                
          FX Batch
          
                
          A fixed package of FX Trades compatible by Batching Key—Client Deals, Hedge Deals, and technical FX Trades—whose aggregate open currency position is zero. After formation, its members are excluded from the active FX Position view, which organizes trades and simplifies control of the current currency position.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Batching
          
                
          A manual or automatic process that selects, validates, groups and neutralizes FX Trades compatible by Batching Key to form one or more FX Batches. A user selects FX Trades for Manual Batching; configured rules select them for Automatic Batching.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          FX Trade
          
                
          A Client Deal, Hedge Deal, or technical FX transaction included in currency-position calculations and displayed in FX Position.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Client Deal
          
                
          An FX Trade executed with a client and forming the client component of the currency position.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Hedge Deal
          
                
          An FX Trade executed with a hedge counterparty to manage or neutralize the currency position.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          FX Position
          
                
          Application interface for monitoring the currency position and performing operations with FX Trades, including Batching.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Execution Context
          
                
          A configuration context that determines how an FX Trade is processed for pricing, position management, and other applicable processes. In the current demo, it is defined by the combination of Servicing Location, Accounting System (when applicable), and Execution System.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Servicing Location
          
                
          The organizational and geographic point at which an FX Trade is serviced, such as a branch or head office in a particular region.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Accounting System
          
                
          An internal system of record of a bank or financial institution in which an FX Trade and its related accounting entries are registered.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Execution System
          
                
          The system or execution channel in which an FX Trade is actually executed. Its Pricing Mode describes how the execution price is produced or approved.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Pricing Mode
          
                
          An Execution System attribute describing how the execution price is produced or approved: AUTO_PRICED means automatic pricing, DEALER_PRICED means the dealer sets the price, and DEALER_APPROVED means a system-proposed price requires dealer approval.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Market Pulse
          
                
          An application module that provides current normalized market quotes (Bid and Offer) for currency pairs to pricing, validation, and risk-management processes. In the current demo, quotes are generated by a simulator; the domain concept is independent of the data source and may later use real market-data feeds.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Transfer Rate
          
                
          An internal accounting rate of an FX Trade used to calculate its currency position and allocate analytical P&L. Historically, it was the rate at which a Client Deal was transferred from the Sales book to the book of the desk managing and hedging the position. In the current application no trade is actually transferred between books or systems; the industry term is retained for the internal calculation rate.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Base Currency
          
                
          The first currency in a currency pair; its amount forms the base currency leg of an FX Trade.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Quote Currency
          
                
          The second currency in a currency pair, in which the value of the Base Currency is expressed.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Trade Date
          
                
          The date on which an FX Trade is executed; Tenor and Value Dates are determined relative to it.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Tenor
          
                
          The settlement term of an FX Trade relative to Trade Date. The current model uses TOD, TOM and SPOT.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Value Date
          
                
          The settlement date for one currency leg of an FX Trade. Base Currency Value Date and Quote Currency Value Date are determined separately.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Batching Key
          
                
          A composite compatibility key that determines whether FX Trades may be included in one FX Batch. It always includes the currency pair, Trade Date, and both currency precisions. When Cross-Tenor Batching is disabled, it also includes Tenor and both Value Dates. When Cross-Tenor Batching is enabled, these parameters may differ because the trades are aligned to a common Tenor using a Batch Internal Swap.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Cross-Tenor Batching
          
                
          A Batching mode that allows compatible FX Trades with different Tenors and Value Dates to be included in one FX Batch. Before formation, their settlement terms are aligned to a common Tenor using a Batch Internal Swap.
          
              
          
              
          
                
          Batch Internal Swap
          
                
          An internal technical entity of an FX Batch that aligns FX Trades with different settlement profiles to a common Tenor. It is not a standalone market trade; resulting positions are aggregated across FX Batches and offset by a single net swap at the end of the accounting day.
